SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.MXOPS_V97__analyzeH: Analyze Host: one item per net success (Security Rating or a subsystem), all at 7, VR2 p. 111 (book) or everything on a success (v965)
Analyze Host (book): successes that tell everything (7)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.MXOPS_V97__operatio: System operations: Analyze Subsystem, Crash Application, Decoy, Disinfect, Dump Log, Locate Decker/Frame/IC, Retrain and Scan Icon in the catalog, VR2 p. 162 (book) or not (v965)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.MXOPS_V97__locateDe: Locate Decker (book): the Sensor Test's TN (the book gives none; 4)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.MXOPS_V97__decoyBox: Decoy (book): boxes in a decoy's Condition Monitor (10)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.MXOPS_V97__validate: Validate Passcode: superuser +2 / supervisor +6 TN, lasts 1D6 × net successes days, deleted at an active alert, VR2 p. 118 (book) or for ever (v965)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.MXOPS_V97__slow: Slow utility: Slow rating vs the cybercombat TN, opposed by the IC's Security Value vs the rating; an action per 2 net; not on reactive IC, VR2 p. 99 (book) or Computer vs the IC's rating, Initiative per net (v965)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.MXOPS_V97__slowPerA: Slow (book): Initiative points one action is worth (10)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.MXOPS_V97__restore: Restore utility: rating vs the damaging program's rating, a point per 2 successes, no deck damage, no wear, VR2 p. 100 (book) or the old TN and a point per success (v965)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.MXOPS_V97__interrog: Interrogations: the question's TN modifier (+2 … −2) and "not here" once 3 successes are counted, VR2 p. 110 (book) or neither (v965)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.MXOPS_V97__notThere: Interrogations (book): successes after which the host says it does not hold what is sought (3)
SR2E.MxOps97.Why.scanTarget: Pick a decker, frame or agent in this host that you have located (Locate Decker, Locate Frame) to scan.
SR2E.MxOps97.Why.slowReactive: {name} is reactive IC: the slow utility does not work on it (VR2 p. 99).
SR2E.MxOps97.Why.slowTrace: {name} has locked on: trace IC is open to the slow utility only while it hunts (VR2 p. 99).
SR2E.MxOps97.AnalyzeHost.nothing: No successes to spend: nothing learned.
SR2E.MxOps97.CrashApp.done: {by} crashes an application on the {sub} subsystem. GM: which one; it does not touch IC, frames, constructs or deckers.
SR2E.MxOps97.Disinfect.done: {by} destroys the worms on the {sub} subsystem (GM: any there are gone).
SR2E.MxOps97.Retrain.done: {by} retrains the I/O bandwidth (the optional bandwidth rule, VR2 p. 90, is the GM's to track).
SR2E.MxOps97.Decoy.made: {name} puts up a decoy ({n} successes): proactive IC that attack them roll 1D6, and on {n} or less hit the decoy.
SR2E.MxOps97.Decoy.frame: A frame's decoy: the GM runs it.
SR2E.MxOps97.Decoy.drawn: {ic} attacks {name}'s decoy instead (1D6 {d6} against {n}): {level} damage, the decoy has {boxes} of {max} boxes filled.
SR2E.MxOps97.DumpLog.open: {name} opens {host}'s access log: the GM answers their questions (an interrogation).
SR2E.MxOps97.DumpLog.file: The 24-hour log ({size} Mp) can be downloaded.
SR2E.MxOps97.DumpLog.label: {by} opens the access log
SR2E.MxOps97.Locate.noFrames: No smart frame or agent running here.
SR2E.MxOps97.NotThere.line: {total} successes: the host does not hold what is sought.
SR2E.MxOps97.Passcode.days: The {level} passcode lasts {days} days (1D6 {d6} × {net}), unless the host goes to an active alert while they use it.
SR2E.MxOps97.Passcode.alert: {host}'s active alert flags the passcodes of {names} as illegal: deleted.
SR2E.MxOps97.Slow.label: {name} {rating} slows {target}: TN {tn} (cybercombat); its Resistance Test {dice} dice vs {rtn}: {resistance} successes
SR2E.MxOps97.Slow.actions: It loses {actions} action(s) this turn ({initiative} Initiative; {net} net over its {resistance}).
SR2E.MxOps97.Slow.none: No action lost ({net} net over its {resistance}; it takes 2).
SR2E.MxOps97.Slow.hangs: It has no action left: it hangs until the next turn.
SR2E.MxOps97.Slow.hint: Slow rating (+ Hacking Pool) vs the cybercombat TN, opposed by the IC's Resistance Test (Security Value vs the Slow rating); every 2 net successes take an action ({per} Initiative) this turn. Not on reactive IC; on trace IC only while it hunts.
SR2E.MxOps97.Restore.hint: Restore rating vs the rating of the program that crippled the icon; a point per 2 successes. It cannot mend the deck's permanent damage.
SR2E.MxOps97.Restore.label: {name} {rating}: Restore Test vs {tn} (the damaging program's rating)
SR2E.MxOps97.Decoy.label: {by} puts up a decoy
SR2E.MxOps97.Locate.label: {by} locates icons
SR2E.MxOps97.Scan.gone: The icon is no longer here (or no longer located): nothing learned.
SR2E.MxOps97.Trust.decoyAll: a decoy for {name} ({n} successes): it draws every proactive IC attack
